nodes.label: Existing Graph Fast Path
nodes.rationale: Reuse graph.json for natural-language questions to avoid needless detection and extraction.

nodes.label: Prompt-Aware Semantic Cache
nodes.rationale: Prompt attribution invalidates stale cache entries after extraction prompt upgrades.

nodes.label: Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: A read-only gate exposes silent corruption without making a usable graph unavailable.

nodes.label: Deterministic Node IDs
nodes.rationale: Full repo-relative paths prevent ghost duplicates and preserve update identity.

nodes.label: Constrained Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: Selecting only tokens present in graph labels prevents invented synonyms while handling wording mismatches.

nodes.label: Replace on Re-extract
nodes.rationale: Replacing changed sources prevents stale nodes while pruning only genuinely deleted files.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Conventions
nodes.rationale: Repository-local Next.js documentation must be consulted because this version differs from familiar APIs and conventions.

nodes.label: Ledger Lines AI Piano Practice Coach
nodes.norm_label: ledger lines ai piano practice coach

nodes.label: ONNX Runtime fp32
nodes.rationale: ONNX fp32 is about twice as fast with bit-identical output, while int8 is slower for the convolution-heavy model.

nodes.label: Five-metric Evaluation Model
nodes.rationale: Articulation was removed because microphone-derived note offsets are unreliable.

nodes.label: Relative Progress Display
nodes.rationale: Recording conditions destabilize absolute scores, so prior-take changes and detectable-difference thresholds are primary.

nodes.label: Jump-enabled Event DTW
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary-position jumps support restarts and partial practice while retaining O(N·M) complexity.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Analysis and Notification
nodes.rationale: Transcription latency makes synchronous waiting impractical even after ONNX acceleration.

nodes.label: Cosmos DB Song Partition
nodes.rationale: Take comparisons are song-local, so takes use /songId rather than /userId.

nodes.label: Constrained LLM Coaching Role
nodes.rationale: The LLM translates predetermined analysis into language and hypotheses but never scores or invents facts.

nodes.label: AI Output Validation V1-V9
nodes.rationale: Machine verification is the third defense layer against unsupported measure references, numbers, metrics, and contradictory trends.

nodes.label: Nonblocking AI Generation
nodes.rationale: Scores become viewable before commentary, chat streams, and stagnation diagnosis runs asynchronously.

nodes.label: Deferred Application Services
nodes.rationale: Web and worker deployment stay unconfigured until container images are published.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Audio/MIDI and a score are processed asynchronously because transcription takes minutes on CPU.

nodes.label: S3 Two-stage Score Alignment
nodes.rationale: Event-level DTW followed by note matching handles chords more stably than note-level DTW.

nodes.label: Jump-enabled DTW
nodes.rationale: Arbitrary score-position jumps support retries and partial practice while preserving O(N*M) complexity.

nodes.label: Idempotent Analysis Jobs
nodes.rationale: Queue processing must tolerate duplicate delivery and resume from stored intermediate artifacts.

nodes.label: Azure Container Apps
nodes.rationale: Selected over App Service and AKS for independent web/worker scaling, scale-to-zero workers, and lower operational burden.

nodes.label: Cosmos DB Serverless
nodes.rationale: Serverless is cheaper at MVP traffic until 5,000 RU/s or 20GB partition limits approach.

nodes.label: Azure Storage Queue
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Service Bus because the MVP needs simple at-least-once job delivery rather than advanced messaging features.

nodes.label: Bicep and azd Infrastructure as Code
nodes.norm_label: bicep and azd infrastructure as code

nodes.label: Recording Data Durability
nodes.rationale: Raw recordings are the most valuable data because derived analysis can be recomputed but performances cannot be recreated.

nodes.label: Short-lived SAS Access
nodes.rationale: Clients do not directly own storage credentials; the API issues narrowly scoped, short-lived URLs.

nodes.label: Azure What-if Review
nodes.rationale: Previewing resource-group changes prevents unintended destructive updates.

nodes.label: Cloud-backed Local Development
nodes.rationale: Only Next.js runs locally while isolated real Azure services provide the recommended integration profile.

nodes.label: Emulator Security Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Connection keys and relaxed certificate handling are restricted to emulator mode and forbidden in cloud deployments.

nodes.label: Articulation Metric Rejection
nodes.rationale: Microphone transcription offset has about +300ms bias and loses release-time evidence, so articulation is excluded from MVP.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Processing Decision
nodes.rationale: CPU transcription gives roughly 4.3 minutes for a three-minute performance and gains little from extra threads.

nodes.label: Relative-score-first UI
nodes.rationale: Recording conditions can shift the same performance from overall 89 to 61, making absolute scores unsuitable as the primary UI signal.

nodes.label: ONNX fp32 Transcription
nodes.rationale: Fixed 10-second inputs allow a simple opset-17 export that is roughly twice as fast with bit-identical output.

nodes.label: int8 Quantization Rejection
nodes.rationale: Dynamic Conv quantization lacks an optimized path, runs 8-9 times slower, and introduces output error.

nodes.label: Visual Metronome Guidance
nodes.rationale: Visual cues avoid click contamination that reduced note F1 by seven points.

nodes.label: MusicXML Tie Merging
nodes.rationale: Tied notation must become one sounding note or alignment will compare one performance onset to multiple reference notes.

nodes.label: Resource-oriented REST API
nodes.rationale: A Next.js-only client does not need GraphQL flexibility; REST improves caching and debugging.

nodes.label: Analysis Failure History
nodes.rationale: Analysis failures remain normal take records so users can revisit why processing failed.

nodes.label: Diagnosis Rather Than Grading
nodes.rationale: Scores serve to locate actionable weak measures rather than rank performances.

nodes.label: Confidence and Explainability
nodes.rationale: Low-confidence measures are withheld from scores and AI context to avoid confidently wrong advice.

nodes.label: Performance Metrics Framework
nodes.rationale: Scores identify practice targets while dead zones protect musical expression and perceptually insignificant deviation.

nodes.label: BeatMap
nodes.rationale: Mapping absolute seconds to beats permits rhythm evaluation despite tempo fluctuation.
